gui.soundsystem_dj.booth: BOOTH MONITOR: level for whoever is stood at the booth
gui.soundsystem_dj.guide1: Type a song or paste a link, press Enter
gui.soundsystem_dj.guide2: Drag or scroll any knob · shift = fine · double-click = reset · hover = value
gui.soundsystem_dj.hotcue: Hot cue %s: click sets or jumps
gui.soundsystem_dj.eq_hi: HI EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.soundsystem_dj.eq_mid: MID EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.soundsystem_dj.eq_low: LOW EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.soundsystem_dj.filter: COLOR filter (left = low-pass, right = high-pass, double-click = off)
gui.soundsystem_dj.echo: Echo FX (drag up for more; double-click = off)
gui.soundsystem_dj.eq_curve: EQ CURVE: ISO kills the band, EQ cuts to -26 dB
gui.soundsystem_dj.fader_curve: CH FADER curve: SLOW / LIN / SHARP
gui.soundsystem_dj.tap: Tap on the beat to measure BPM
gui.soundsystem_dj.xf_assign: CROSS FADER ASSIGN: A / THRU (off the crossfader) / B
gui.soundsystem_dj.color_param: PARAMETER: how strong the SOUND COLOR FX is
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.space: SPACE: reverb. Left adds it to the low/mid, right to the mid/high
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.dub_echo: DUB ECHO: echo repeats. Left keeps them mid-range, right extends them up
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.sweep: SWEEP: left gates the sound tighter, right narrows a band-pass
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.noise: NOISE: white noise through a filter. Left lowers its cutoff, right raises it
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.crush: CRUSH: left drives it into distortion, right crushes then high-passes
gui.soundsystem_dj.color.filter: FILTER: left sweeps a low-pass down, right sweeps a high-pass up
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.delay: DELAY: one repeat, one beat fraction behind the original
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.echo: ECHO: repeats that fade out, for trailing off a track
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.ping_pong: PING PONG: the repeats bounce between left and right
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.spiral: SPIRAL: reverb-like repeats that drift in pitch as they decay
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.reverb: REVERB: adds a room around the sound. DEPTH sets how much
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.trans: TRANS: chops the sound on and off on the beat. DEPTH sets the gap
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.filter: FILTER: the cutoff sweeps up and down once per beat fraction
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.flanger: FLANGER: one flange sweep per beat fraction, that jet-plane whoosh
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.phaser: PHASER: sweeping notches, softer and more swirly than a flanger
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.pitch: PITCH: shifts the pitch. DEPTH sets how far
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.slip_roll: SLIP ROLL: loops the last slice; the track keeps running underneath
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.roll: ROLL: loops the last slice of audio over and over
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.vinyl_brake: VINYL BRAKE: slows to a stop like killing a turntable's motor
gui.soundsystem_dj.beatfx.helix: HELIX: loops a slice and keeps piling new sound on top of it
gui.soundsystem_dj.beat_fraction: Beat fraction the effect is timed to
gui.soundsystem_dj.fx_freq: FX FREQUENCY: which bands the effect is applied to
gui.soundsystem_dj.fx_channel: Which channel the BEAT FX runs on (MASTER = both)
gui.soundsystem_dj.fx_depth: LEVEL/DEPTH: how much of the effect you hear
gui.soundsystem_dj.fx_tap: TAP on the beat to set the BPM the effect is timed to
gui.soundsystem_dj.fx_onoff: Switch the BEAT FX in and out
gui.soundsystem_dj.cue_channel: CUE: preview this channel for the person at the booth only
gui.soundsystem_dj.xfader_curve: CROSS FADER curve: SLOW / LIN / SHARP
gui.soundsystem_dj.direction: DIRECTION: FWD / REV / SLIP REV (reverse with the track running underneath)
gui.soundsystem_dj.slip: SLIP: loops and scratches happen on top; the track carries on underneath
gui.soundsystem_dj.quantize: QUANTIZE: cues, hot cues and loops snap to the beat. Needs a tapped BPM
gui.soundsystem_dj.jog_mode: JOG MODE: VINYL grabs the platter, CDJ only bends the pitch
gui.soundsystem_dj.tempo_reset: TEMPO RESET: back to the track's own speed
gui.soundsystem_dj.beat_sync: BEAT SYNC: match the other deck's tempo. Tap both decks first
gui.soundsystem_dj.track_start: TRACK SEARCH: back to the start of the track
gui.soundsystem_dj.memory: MEMORY: save this spot as a cue you can call back
gui.soundsystem_dj.call_prev: CUE/LOOP CALL: jump to the previous saved cue
gui.soundsystem_dj.call_next: CUE/LOOP CALL: jump to the next saved cue
gui.soundsystem_dj.memory_delete: DELETE: forget the saved cue nearest the playhead
gui.soundsystem_dj.master_tempo: MASTER TEMPO: keep the key when you move the tempo fader
gui.soundsystem_dj.key_sync: KEY SYNC: shift this deck into the other deck's key. Needs track lookup configured
gui.soundsystem_dj.credit_getsongbpm: Tempo and key data by GetSongBPM.com
